text: This is OpenNote. A free notebook where notes can run.
asr: This is OpenNote. A free notebook where notes can run.

text: Write with a stylus, a pen tablet, or a mouse.
Hold still, and a rough circle snaps into a clean shape.
Lasso your work, and move it to any page.
Now the good part. Copy an artifact from your AI chat, paste it, and press Save.
It runs, right between your pages. And you can still write on top of it.
It lives in a sandbox, so it never touches your notes.
Record the lecture while you write. Later, tap any stroke to hear that exact moment.
Transcripts are made on your device, even offline.
Hide key terms under tape, then turn them into flashcards that know when you'll forget.
Need more room? Open an endless whiteboard.
Sign in if you like. Everything is encrypted on your device before it is uploaded.
Web, Android and Windows. No charges. No ads.
